_comment: Genre -> {concept layer -> additive score bias}, applied by resolve_entity_assets in the concept-layer tiers (2a/2c) when schema.meta.genre is set and != 'universal'. Genre names come from rag.tags.taxonomy UNITY_GENRE_ATOM['genre'] (the same vocabulary unity_archetypes.classify emits); layer names from concept_layers.json. Positive = this genre wants assets whose PRIMARY domain is that layer; negative = an asset primarily from that layer is off-genre even when the entity's kind ties them (a racing game's kind='vehicle' opponents must resolve to ground vehicles, never the airplane that shares the 'vehicle' kind_hint). File missing => zero bias, resolver behaves exactly as before. Deterministic: pure lookup.
